newsitem.title: THAILAND: Land and House limit down on share issue.
newsitem.headline: Land and House limit down on share issue.

text.p: Shares of Thai property developer Land and House Plc plunged on Wednesday following the company's surprise announcement of a large rights issue on Tuesday, traders and analysts said.

The stock fell to its daily trading limit, losing 8.50 baht, or 9.60 percent, to 80 baht as foreign investors sold out of the stock to avoid having their shares devalued by the imminent dilution, analysts said.

As part of plans to raise debt and equity capital the company announced it would offer 162.25 million shares to existing shareholders at their 10 baht par value to raise its registered capital to around 3.48 billion baht from its current 1.62 billion baht.
The terms of the share issue came as a surprise to the market, analysts said.

"First of all I think it's not yet clear to investors why such a massive rights issue is set at such a low price, this is a company that is thought to be well-managed and this news was not in the market at all," said Vikas Kawatra, property analyst at Asia Equity.
